options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.
options.doc_html_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.
options.doc_html_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

Full: s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

Minimal: s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Completion Goal
options.doc:
Lets the user choose the completion goal.
Sorceress 1 - Beat the sorceress *and* obtain the specified number of eggs.
Egg For Sale - Chase Moneybags after defeating the sorceress the first time.
Sorceress 2 - Beat the sorceress in Super Bonus Round *and*
    obtain the specified number of eggs.
All Skillpoints - Collect all 20 skill points in the game.
    Excluded locations are still required for this goal.
Epilogue - Unlock the full epilogue by collecting all 20 skill points
    and defeating the sorceress. Excluded locations are still required for this goal.
Spike - Beat Spike *and* obtain the specified number of eggs.
Scorch - Beat Scorch *and* obtain the specified number of eggs.
Egg Hunt - Find the specified number of eggs to win. Portal requirements are reduced.
options.doc_fr:
Permet à l'utilisateur de choisir l'objectif d'achèvement.
Sorceresse 1 - Battre la sorcière *et* obtenir le nombre spécifié d'oeufs.
Egg For Sale - Chase Moneybags après avoir vaincu la sorcière la première fois.
Sorceress 2 - Battre la sorcière en Super Bonus Round *et* obtenir le nombre spécifié d'oeufs.
Tous les points de compétence - Recueillir tous les 20 points de compétence dans le jeu.
    Des emplacements exclus sont toujours nécessaires pour atteindre cet objectif.
Epilogue - Débloquez l'épilogue complet en recueillant les 20 points de compétence et en battant la sorcière. Des emplacements exclus sont toujours nécessaires pour atteindre cet objectif.
Spike - Beat Spike *et* obtiennent le nombre spécifié d'oeufs.
Scorch - Beat Scorch *et* obtiennent le nombre spécifié d'oeufs.
Chasse aux oeufs - Trouvez le nombre spécifié d'oeufs à gagner. Les exigences du portail sont réduites.

options.name: Eggs to Win
options.doc:
The number of eggs needed to win when goal is Sorceress 1,
Sorceress 2, Spike, Scorch, and Egg Hunt.

options.name: Percent Extra Egg Hunt Eggs
options.doc:
The percentage of extra eggs in the pool for Egg Hunt.
For example, if 50 eggs are needed and there are 20% extra eggs,
60 eggs will be in the pool. The total number of available eggs
caps at 150 regardless of this option. Rounds up.

options.name: Guaranteed Items
options.doc: Guarantees that the specified items will be in the item pool
options.doc_fr: Garanties que les articles spécifiés seront dans le pool d'articles

options.name: DeathLink
options.doc:
Spyro will die when a DeathLink is received.
Sends DeathLinks on his death.
Some edge cases may not be handled.
options.doc_html: Spyro will die when a DeathLink is received. Sends DeathLinks on his death. Some edge cases may not be handled.

options.name: Enable 25% Gem Checks
options.doc: Adds checks for getting 25% of the gems in a level
options.doc_fr: Ajoute des contrôles pour obtenir 25% des pierres précieuses dans un niveau

options.name: Enable 50% Gem Checks
options.doc: Adds checks for getting 50% of the gems in a level
options.doc_fr: Ajoute des contrôles pour obtenir 50% des pierres précieuses dans un niveau

options.name: Enable 75% Gem Checks
options.doc: Adds checks for getting 75% of the gems in a level
options.doc_fr: Ajoute des contrôles pour obtenir 75% des pierres précieuses dans un niveau

options.name: Enable 100% Gem Checks
options.doc: Adds checks for getting all gems in a level
options.doc_fr: Ajoute des contrôles pour obtenir toutes les pierres précieuses dans un niveau

options.name: Enable Total Gem Count Checks
options.doc:
Adds checks for every 500 gems you collect total.
Gems currently paid to Moneybags do not count towards your total.
Logic assumes you pay Moneybags everywhere.
options.doc_fr:
Ajoute des chèques pour chaque 500 gemmes que vous collectez au total.
Gems actuellement payés à Moneybags ne comptent pas pour votre total.
Logic suppose que vous payez des sacs à argent partout.

options.name: Max for Total Gem Count Checks
options.doc:
The highest number of total gems that can be required for Total Gem Count checks.
Has no effect if Enable Total Gem Count Checks is disabled.

options.name: Enable Gemsanity
options.doc:
Adds checks for individual gems.
If Moneybagssanity is off, Moneybags unlocks become free.
WARNING: Full gemsanity requires the host to edit allow_full_gemsanity
    in their yaml file.
Off: Individual gems are not checks.
Partial: 200 random gems become checks. Adds items giving 50 or 100 gems
    for specific levels to the item pool.
Full Bundles: Every gem is a check.  Adds items giving 50 or 100 gems
    for specific levels to the item pool.  Adds many filler items.
options.doc_fr:
Ajoute des vérifications pour chaque bijou.
Si Moneybagssanity est éteint, les déverrouillages de Moneybags deviennent gratuits.
WARNING: La gemsanity complète nécessite que l'hôte modifie allow full gemsanity dans son fichier yaml.
Off: Les gemmes individuelles ne sont pas des chèques.
Partial: 200 pierres précieuses au hasard deviennent des chèques. Ajoute des articles donnant 50 ou 100 gemmes pour des niveaux spécifiques au pool d'articles.
Full Bundles: Chaque bijou est un chèque. Ajoute des articles donnant 50 ou 100 gemmes pour des niveaux spécifiques au pool d'articles. Ajoute de nombreux éléments de remplissage.

options.name: Enable Skillpoint Checks
options.doc: Adds checks for getting skill points
options.doc_fr: Ajoute des contrôles pour obtenir des points de compétence

options.name: Enable Life Bottle Checks
options.doc:
Adds checks for breaking life bottles.
Off: Life bottles are not checks.
Normal: The 26 intended life bottles become checks.
Hard: Adds the out-of-bounds life bottle in Fireworks Factory to the pool.
This does not include the 3 bottles on the impossible island in Midnight Mountain.
options.doc_fr:
Ajoute des contrôles pour casser les bouteilles de vie.
Off: Les bouteilles de vie ne sont pas des chèques.
Normal: Les 26 bouteilles de vie prévues deviennent des contrôles.
Hard: Ajoute à la piscine la bouteille de vie en dehors de l'usine Fireworks.
Cela ne comprend pas les 3 bouteilles sur l'île impossible de Midnight Mountain.

options.name: Open World Mode
options.doc:
Grants access to all 4 homeworlds from the start.
End of level and boss eggs are removed as checks.
This removes 18 locations from the location pool,
so you may need to enable additional locations to use this option.
If Moneybags is Vanilla, companion unlocks will be free.
Disables world keys.
options.doc_fr:
Accorde l'accès aux quatre mondes d'origine dès le départ.
Fin du niveau et les oeufs de patron sont enlevés comme des vérifications.
Cela supprime 18 emplacements de la piscine d'emplacement, de sorte que vous pourriez avoir besoin de permettre des emplacements supplémentaires pour utiliser cette option.
Si Moneybags est Vanilla, les déverrouillages de compagnon seront gratuits.
Désactive les clés du monde.

options.name: Level Lock Options
options.doc:
Determines the rules for entering levels.
Sparx levels, companion levels, homeworlds, Super Bonus Round, and bosses
are not affected by these settings.
At least one Sunrise level will always start unlocked.
Some settings give a free egg to ensure correct behavior.
Some settings prevent non-companion levels from out of bounds.
Vanilla: Levels have their vanilla unlock requirements.
Keys: 20 Level Unlock items are added to the item pool.
Randomize Requirements: Randomizes egg requirements for levels
    that normally require eggs to enter.
Add Requirements: Any level can have an egg requirement added.
Add Gem Requirements: Any level can have an egg OR gem requirement added.
    Only works when both Moneybagssanity and Gemsanity are on.
options.doc_fr:
Déterminer les règles d'entrée des niveaux.
Les niveaux de sparx, les niveaux de compagnes, les homeworlds, Super Bonus Round et les patrons ne sont pas affectés par ces paramètres.
Au moins un niveau Sunrise sera toujours déverrouillé.
Certains paramètres donnent un oeuf libre pour assurer un comportement correct.
Certains paramètres empêchent les niveaux de non-compagnation de sortir des limites.
Vanilla: Les niveaux ont leurs exigences de déverrouillage de vanille.
Keys: 20 Niveau Déverrouiller les articles sont ajoutés au pool d'articles.
Randomize Requirements: Randomise les exigences en matière d'oeufs pour les niveaux qui exigent normalement l'entrée des oeufs.
Add Requirements: N'importe quel niveau peut avoir une exigence d'oeuf ajouté.
Add Gem Requirements: N'importe quel niveau peut avoir une exigence d'œuf OU gemme ajoutée.
    Ce n'est que lorsque Moneybagssanity et Gemsanity sont sur.

options.name: Number of Starting Levels
options.doc:
When Level Lock Options is not Vanilla or Randomize Requirements,
determines how many non-companion levels start unlocked.
The recommended value when Keys are in use is 2 or 3.
One Sunrise level will always be unlocked.

options.name: Eggs to Open Sorceress Door
options.doc:
Determines how many eggs are required to open Sorceress' Lair
in Midnight Mountain.
NOTE: This only works if Duckstation is set to interpreter mode.
options.doc_fr:
Détermine le nombre d'oeufs requis pour ouvrir la tanière de la Sorceresse à Midnight Mountain.
NOTE: Cela ne fonctionne que si Duckstation est configuré en mode interprète.

options.name: Eggs to Open Super Bonus Round
options.doc:
Determines how many eggs are required to open Super Bonus Round.
NOTE: This only works if Duckstation is set to interpreter mode.
options.doc_fr:
Détermine combien d'oeufs sont nécessaires pour ouvrir Super Bonus Round.
NOTE: Cela ne fonctionne que si Duckstation est configuré en mode interprète.

options.name: Gems to Open Super Bonus Round
options.doc:
Determines how many gems are required to open Super Bonus Round.
Gem requirements within Super Bonus Round are based on this number.
NOTE: This only works if Duckstation is set to interpreter mode.
In game displays may have visual glitches.
options.doc_fr:
Détermine combien de gemmes sont nécessaires pour ouvrir Super Bonus Round.
Les exigences de gemme dans Super Bonus Round sont basées sur ce nombre.
NOTE: Cela ne fonctionne que si Duckstation est configuré en mode interprète.
Dans les écrans de jeu peuvent avoir des problèmes visuels.

options.name: Moneybags Settings
options.doc:
Determines settings for Moneybags unlocks.
Moneybags dialog has small visual errors.
Defeating the Sorceress bypasses all requirements.
Vanilla - Pay Moneybags to progress as usual
Companionsanity - Unlock items replace payment for side characters.
Moneybagssanity - Unlock items replace payment for Moneybags.
options.doc_fr:
Détermine les paramètres des déverrouillages de Moneybags.
La boîte de dialogue Sacs à argent comporte de petites erreurs visuelles.
La défaite de la Sorceresse contourne toutes les exigences.
Vanilla - Pay Moneybags pour progresser comme d'habitude
Companionsanity - Débloquer les éléments remplacent le paiement pour les caractères latéraux.
Sacs à argent - Débloquer les articles remplacent le paiement pour Sacs à argent.

options.name: Powerup Lock Settings
options.doc:
Powerup gates (such as superflame) require items to use.
Does not affect the invincibility filler item.
NOTE: The Sunrise Spring early level entry tricks assume
    you do not need the superfly powerup to complete them!
Vanilla - Powerups are available at all times.
Type - Superfly, Fireball, and Invincibility Powerup items are added to the pool.
    Fireworks Factory and Super Bonus Round's combo powerups
    require both Superfly and Fireball to unlock.
Individual: Each level's powerups are unlocked by a specific item.

options.name: Enable World Keys
options.doc:
Prevents moving to the next homeworld without enough World Key items.
You must still complete the vanilla requirements to go to the next homeworld.
Disabled in Open World mode.

options.name: Enable Midnight Whirlwind
options.doc:
Adds a whirlwind outside the Sorceress' Lair leading to the impossible
island with 3 life bottles, once the Sorceress has been defeated.
Puts these bottles into the item pool if life bottles are enabled.
options.doc_fr:
Ajoute un tourbillon à l'extérieur de la Tanière de la Sorceresse menant à l'île impossible avec 3 bouteilles de vie, une fois la Sorceresse vaincue.
Mettre ces bouteilles dans la piscine si les bouteilles de vie sont activées.

options.name: Enable Extra Lives Filler
options.doc: Enables filler items that grant extra lives
options.doc_fr: Active les éléments de remplissage qui accordent des vies supplémentaires

options.name: Enable Temporary Invincibility Filler
options.doc: Enables filler items that grant temporary invincibility
options.doc_fr: Permet aux articles de remplissage qui accordent une invincibilité temporaire

options.name: Enable Changing Spyro's Color Filler
options.doc: Enables filler items that change Spyro's color
options.doc_fr: Active les éléments de remplissage qui changent la couleur de Spyro

options.name: Enable Big Head and Flat Spyro Filler
options.doc: Enables filler items that turn on Big Head Mode and Flat Spyro Mode
options.doc_fr: Active les éléments de remplissage qui s'allument en mode Big Head et en mode Spyro plat

options.name: Enable (over)healing Sparx Filler
options.doc: Enables filler items that heal Sparx. Can exceed max health.
options.doc_fr: Active les éléments de remplissage qui guérissent Sparx. Peut dépasser la santé maximale.

options.name: Trap Percentage of Filler
options.doc: The percent chance that a filler items is a trap.

options.name: Enable Hurting Sparx Trap
options.doc: Enables traps that damage Sparx. Cannot directly kill Spyro.
options.doc_fr: Active les pièges qui endommagent Sparx. Je ne peux pas tuer directement Spyro.

options.name: Enable Sparxless Trap
options.doc: Enables traps that removes Sparx.
options.doc_fr: Active les pièges qui suppriment Sparx.

options.name: Sparx Power-sanity Settings
options.doc:
Shuffles the Sparx abilities from completing Sparx levels into the item pool.
Sparx's ability to break baskets becomes 2 progressive items.
Having both allows atlas warp and breaking vases.

options.name: Enable Progressive Sparx Health Upgrades
options.doc:
Start the game with less max health.
Add items to the pool to increase your max health.
Heal Sparx items have no effect until all items are found.
Off - The game behaves normally.
Blue - Your max health starts at blue Sparx.
Green - Your max health starts at green Sparx.
Sparxless - Your max health starts at no Sparx.
True Sparxless - Your max health is permanently Sparxless.

options.name: Enable Progressive Sparx Health Logic
options.doc:
Certain Sparx health amounts are expected before
you are required to enter different levels.
Super Bonus Round, Crawdad Farm, and levels in Midday and later
logically require green Sparx.
Fireworks Factory, Charmed Ridge, and levels in Midnight and later
logically require blue Sparx.
Dino Mines and the Sorceress logically require
gold Sparx.
The Extra Health item/bonus from Starfish Reef is not considered for this logic.
Note: This does nothing unless Enable Progressive Sparx
Health Upgrades is set to blue, green, or Sparxless,
options.doc_fr:
Certaines quantités de Sparx santé sont attendues avant que vous êtes tenu d'entrer différents niveaux.
Super Bonus Round, Crawdad Farm, et les niveaux dans Midday et plus tard nécessitent logiquement vert Sparx.
Fireworks Factory, Charmed Ridge, et les niveaux à Midnight et plus tard nécessitent logiquement Sparx bleu.
Dino Mines et la Sorceresse nécessitent logiquement de l'or Sparx.
L'élément/bonus extra-santé de Starfish Reef n'est pas pris en compte dans cette logique.
Note: Cela ne fait rien à moins d'activer Progressive Sparx
Améliorations de la santé est mis à bleu, vert, ou Sparxless,

options.name: Require Sparx for Max Gems
options.doc:
Determines the logic for gemsanity and 100% gem checks.
75% gem checks (100% in levels with no enemies) are always on.
Off: Sparx max health and abilities do not affect gem logic.
Green Sparx: Sparx is required.
Sparx Finder: Sparx Gem Finder is required.
NOTE: This option is ignored in True Sparxless mode,
or in Sparxless mode if Progressive Sparx Health Logic is off.
options.doc_fr:
Détermine la logique de la gemsanité et des contrôles à 100%.
75% des contrôles de gemme (100% en niveaux sans ennemis) sont toujours en cours.
Off: Sparx max santé et capacités n'affectent pas la logique de gemme.
Green Sparx: Sparx est nécessaire.
Sparx Finder: Sparx Gem Finder est nécessaire.
NOTE: Cette option est ignorée en mode True Sparxless, ou en mode Sparxless si Progressive Sparx Health Logic est désactivé.

options.name: Number of Zoe Hints
options.doc:
Some or all of the 13 Tutorial Zoes give hints.
Which Zoes give hints are random.
Hints include:
- Difficult or slow locations
- Progression items in your world
- Joke hints

options.name: Easy Skateboarding Lizards
options.doc:
The Sunny Villa lizard skateboarding challenges require only 1 lizard.
Results in minor graphical glitches.

options.name: Easy Skateboarding Points
options.doc:
Point-based skateboarding challenges in Sunny Villa
and Enchanted Towers become much easier.
Includes skill points.

options.name: Easy Skateboarding Lost Fleet
options.doc: Your turbo cannot run out in the Lost Fleet skateboarding challenges.

options.name: Easy Skateboarding Super Bonus Round
options.doc: Your turbo cannot run out in the Super Bonus Round skateboarding challenge.

options.name: Easy Boxing
options.doc: The enemy yeti in Frozen Altars boxing has only 1 health.

options.name: Easy Spooky Sheila Missions
options.doc: Rocks and mushrooms never respawn in Spooky Swamp's Sheila sub-area.

options.name: Easy Tanks
options.doc:
The Tanks challenges in Haunted Tomb will require only 1 tank each.
Results in minor graphical glitches.

options.name: Easy Subs
options.doc:
The Lost Fleet submarine challenges require ony 1 sub.
The HUD will incorrectly display 1/1.

options.name: Easy Bluto
options.doc: Bluto in Seashell Shores has only 1 health.
options.doc_fr: Bluto dans Seashell Shores n'a que 1 santé.

options.name: Easy Sleepyhead
options.doc: Sleepyhead in Spooky Swamp has only 1 health.

options.name: Easy Shark Riders
options.doc:
The Shark Riders challenge in Desert Ruins requires only 1 shark,
which starts to the left of the building.

options.name: Easy Whack-a-Mole
options.doc: The Bentley Whack-A-Mole challenge in Crystal Islands require only 1 mole.

options.name: Easy Tunnels
options.doc: Water tunnels in Seashell Shore and Dino Mines move slightly more slowly.

options.name: Convert Scorch Green Rockets to Red
options.doc: Collecting a green rocket in Scorch will automatically convert to 50 red rockets instead.
options.doc_fr: La collecte d'une fusée verte à Scorch se convertira automatiquement en 50 fusées rouges.

options.name: Enter Sunny Villa Sheila Area Early
options.doc:
Potentially require entering Sunny Villa's Sheila sub-area from out of bounds.
NOTE: Entering this area from behind may crash the game if done incorrectly.
This option only matters is Companionsanity or Moneybagssanity is turned on.

options.name: Cloud Spires Backwards
options.doc:
Potentially require completing Cloud Spires backwards
without paying Moneybags or beating the Sorceress.
This option only matters if Moneybagssanity is turned on.

options.name: Enter Molten Crater Early
options.doc: Potentially require entering Molten Crater from out of bounds.

options.name: Enter Molten Crater Sgt. Byrd Area Early
options.doc: Potentially require entering Molten Crater's Sgt. Byrd sub-area from out of bounds

options.name: Enter Molten Crater Thieves without Moneybags
options.doc:
Potentially require entering Molten Crater's Thieves sub-area from out of bounds
without paying Moneybags or beating the Sorceress.
This option only matters if Moneybagssanity is turned on.

options.name: Enter Seashell Shores Early
options.doc: Potentially require entering Seashell Shores from out of bounds.

options.name: Enter Seashell Shores Sheila Area Early
options.doc: Potentially require entering Seashell Shores' Sheila sub-area from out of bounds.

options.name: Enter Mushroom Speedway Early
options.doc: Potentially require entering Mushroom Speedway from out of bounds.

options.name: Enter Sheila's Alp Early
options.doc:
Potentially require entering Sheila's Alp from out of bounds
without paying Moneybags or beating the Sorceress.
This option only matters if Companionsanity or Moneybagssanity is turned on.

options.name: Enter Spooky Swamp Early
options.doc: Potentially require entering Spooky Swamp from out of bounds.

options.name: Skip Moneybags in Spooky Swamp
options.doc:
Potentially require getting to the end of Spooky Swamp
without paying Moneybags or beating the Sorceress.
This option only matters if Moneybagssanity is turned on.

options.name: Enter Bamboo Terrace Early
options.doc: Potentially require entering Bamboo Terrace from out of bounds.

options.name: Enter Bamboo Terrace Bentley Area Early
options.doc: Potentially require entering the Bamboo Terrace Bentley sub-area from out of bounds.

options.name: Enter Country Speedway Early
options.doc: Potentially require entering Country Speedway from out of bounds.

options.name: Enter Sgt. Byrd's Base Early
options.doc:
Potentially require entering Sgt. Byrd's Base from out of bounds
without paying Moneybags or beating the Sorceress.
This option only matters if Companionsanity or Moneybagssanity is turned on.

options.name: Enter Frozen Altars Bentley Area Early
options.doc:
Potentially require entering the Frozen Altars Bentley sub-area from out of bounds.
This option only matters if Companionsanity or Moneybagssaniity is turned on.

options.name: Enter Frozen Altars Cat Hockey Area without Moneybags
options.doc:
Potentially require entering the Frozen Altars cat hockey minigame
without paying Moneybags or beating the Sorceress.
This option only matters if Moneybagssanity is turned on.

options.name: Enter Fireworks Factory Early
options.doc: Potentially require entering Fireworks Factory from out of bounds.

options.name: Enter Fireworks Factory Agent 9 Area Early
options.doc:
Potentially require entering Fireworks Factory's Agent 9 sub-area
out of bounds.

options.name: Enter Charmed Ridge Early
options.doc: Potentially require entering Charmed Ridge from out of bounds.

options.name: Pass Charmed Ridge Stairs without Moneybags
options.doc:
Potentially require getting past the stairs in Charmed Ridge
without paying Moneybags or beating the Sorceress.
This option only matters if Moneybagssanity is turned on.

options.name: Enter Honey Speedway Early
options.doc: Potentially require entering Honey Speedway from out of bounds.

options.name: Enter Bentley's Outpost Early
options.doc:
Potentially require entering Bentley's Outpost
from out of bounds.
This option only matters if Companionsanity or Moneybagssanity is turned on.

options.name: Complete Crystal Islands without Moneybags
options.doc:
Potentially require fully completing Crystal Islands
without paying Moneybags or beating the Sorceress.
This option only matters if Moneybagssanity is turned on.

options.name: Complete Desert Ruins without Moneybags
options.doc:
Potentially require fully completing Desert Ruins
without paying Moneybags or beating the Sorceress.
This option only matters if Moneybagssanity is turned on.

options.name: Enter Dino Mines Agent 9 Area Early
options.doc:
Potentially require entering the Agent 9 sub-area
of Dino Mines out of bounds.

options.name: Enter Sorceress' Lair Early
options.doc:
Potentially require entering Sorceress' Lair out of bounds.
Does not change the door or goal requirements.

options.name: Local Items
options.doc: Forces these items to be in their native world.
options.doc_html: Forces these items to be in their native world.
options.doc_fr: Force ces objets à être dans leur monde d'origine.
options.doc_html_fr: Force ces objets à être dans leur monde d'origine.

options.name: Non-local Items
options.doc: Forces these items to be outside their native world.
options.doc_html: Forces these items to be outside their native world.
options.doc_fr: Force ces objets à être en dehors de leur monde d'origine.
options.doc_html_fr: Force ces objets à être en dehors de leur monde d'origine.

options.name: Start Inventory
options.doc: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}
options.doc_html: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}
options.doc_fr: Commencez par le montant spécifié de ces éléments. Exemple : {Bomb : 1, Flèche : 3}
options.doc_html_fr: Commencez par le montant spécifié de ces éléments. Exemple : {Bomb : 1, Flèche : 3}

options.name: Start Hints
options.doc: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.
options.doc_html: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the !hint command.
options.doc_fr: Commencez par les emplacements de ces éléments préremplis dans la commande ``!hint``.
options.doc_html_fr: Commencez par les emplacements de ces éléments préremplis dans la commande !hint.

options.name: Start Location Hints
options.doc: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.
options.doc_html: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the !hint command.
options.doc_fr: Commencez avec ces emplacements et leur élément prérempli dans la commande ``!hint``.
options.doc_html_fr: Commencez avec ces emplacements et leur élément prérempli dans la commande !hint.

options.name: Excluded Locations
options.doc: Prevent these locations from having an important item.
options.doc_html: Prevent these locations from having an important item.
options.doc_fr: Empêcher ces endroits d'avoir un élément important.
options.doc_html_fr: Empêcher ces endroits d'avoir un élément important.

options.name: Priority Locations
options.doc: Prevent these locations from having an unimportant item.
